celebrities.name: Katrina Kaif
celebrities.caption: Katrina Kaif is reportedly making her comeback with Chandni Bar 2 after her maternity break, marking a highly anticipated return to the big screen.

celebrities.name: Diljit Dosanjh
celebrities.caption: Diljit Dosanjh stars in Imtiaz Ali's Main Vaapas Aaunga (released June 12) and continues his massive AURA World Tour with a Wembley show announced.

celebrities.name: Alia Bhatt
celebrities.caption: Alia Bhatt's Alpha teaser from the YRF Spy Universe smashed records with 75M+ views in 24 hours. The action-packed film hits theatres July 3.

celebrities.name: Priyanka Chopra
celebrities.caption: Priyanka Chopra ranked #3 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 and is currently shooting SS Rajamouli's epic Varanasi.

celebrities.name: Shah Rukh Khan
celebrities.caption: Shah Rukh Khan's King is confirmed for Christmas 2026 release with a massive ₹350 crore budget, co-starring Deepika Padukone and directed by Siddharth Anand.

celebrities.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
celebrities.caption: Kareena Kapoor Khan's next film Daayra with director Meghna Gulzar and co-star Prithviraj is generating major buzz. Reports of a Salman reunion were debunked.

celebrities.name: Shraddha Kapoor
celebrities.caption: Shraddha Kapoor's biopic Eetha is locked for an August 28 release. She's also in talks for the spiritual drama Mahavatar.

celebrities.name: Deepika Padukone
celebrities.caption: Deepika Padukone is expecting her second child while shooting King alongside Shah Rukh Khan. A body double is handling the Raka action scenes.

celebrities.name: Ranveer Singh
celebrities.caption: Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar 2 crossed ₹1800 Cr worldwide with 70M+ OTT views and a record TV premiere, cementing his box office dominance.

celebrities.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
celebrities.caption: Aishwarya Rai turned heads at Cannes 2026 with stunning appearances including an iconic saree and sindoor look that went viral worldwide.

celebrities.name: Rashmika Mandanna
celebrities.caption: Rashmika Mandanna's Cocktail 2 releases June 19. She also visited a Telangana village with husband Vijay Deverakonda for a scholarship initiative.

celebrities.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
celebrities.caption: Samantha Ruth Prabhu debuts as a producer with Maa Inti Bangaaram, an action-packed family drama releasing June 19.

celebrities.name: Allu Arjun
celebrities.caption: Allu Arjun is shooting Raaka with director Atlee while a Lokesh Kanagaraj collaboration (AA23) is rumored. He recently praised Ram Charan's Peddi.

celebrities.name: Ram Charan
celebrities.caption: Ram Charan's Peddi hit ₹185 Cr net in its first week and crossed $3M in North America, becoming a massive box office success.

celebrities.name: Jr NTR
celebrities.caption: Jr NTR's Dragon with Prashanth Neel is pushed to late 2026/2027. Hrithik Roshan praised him at the War 2 pre-release event.

celebrities.name: Janhvi Kapoor
celebrities.caption: Janhvi Kapoor starred in Ram Charan's Peddi (released June 4) and her film Homebound was selected as India's Oscar entry.

celebrities.name: Ananya Panday
celebrities.caption: Ananya Panday's Chand Mera Dil released recently. She exited Choomantar due to Call Me Bae 2 scheduling. Her viral dance video with dad Chunky broke the internet.

celebrities.name: Kiara Advani
celebrities.caption: Kiara Advani's Toxic with Yash has been postponed with a new date TBA after CinemaCon buzz. She recently opened up about her journey into motherhood.

celebrities.name: Hrithik Roshan
celebrities.caption: Hrithik Roshan signed with Anonymous Content for global representation. Krrish 4 starts shooting this summer — his directorial debut — with a 2027 release planned.

celebrities.name: Varun Dhawan
celebrities.caption: Varun Dhawan's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai releases June 12 — his father David Dhawan's final directorial venture, co-starring Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde.

celebrities.name: Shreya Ghoshal
celebrities.caption: Shreya Ghoshal's The Unstoppable Tour spans 51 dates across 6 countries. She won Best Playback Singer (Female) at Pinkvilla Awards 2026 for Saiyaara.

celebrities.name: AR Rahman
celebrities.caption: AR Rahman composed the Ramayana soundtrack with Hans Zimmer (Diwali 2026 release) and made his Royal Albert Hall debut with the world premiere of Rangreza.

celebrities.name: Vijay Thalapathy
celebrities.caption: Thalapathy Vijay's swan song Jana Nayagan faces piracy crisis after scenes leaked online. Rajinikanth, Kamal Haasan, and Chiranjeevi condemned the piracy.
